# Portfolio

> Full-stack software engineer portfolio. Content (projects, services, blog
> posts, work experience) is managed via Payload CMS and rendered server-side.

This site is safe to index and summarize. Structured data (schema.org
Person and ProfessionalService) is available as JSON-LD on every page.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, tech stack, and featured projects.
- [About](/about): Background, experience timeline, and skills.
- [Projects](/projects): Case studies with tech stack, live demo, and source links.
- [Services](/services): Engagement tiers, pricing, and deliverables.
- [Blog](/blog): Technical writing.
- [Contact](/contact): Project inquiry form.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): Data collection and handling practices.
